introduction.en_us:
# MoolingsRconAPI-MCDR

Mooling's Rcon API for MCDReforged.

**NOTE**: The documentation only exposes stable asynchronous interfaces.

## NOTICE

Due to async rcon has added in MCDReforged v2.16, this plugin will no longer maintain, and after no other plugins require it, it will be achieved.
